name: Checker de Pagos SINPE Móvil
author: jeankloai

sections.description:
Dominiosai Checker de Pagos SINPE Móvil para WooCommerce is an integration solution for online stores in Costa Rica that want to automate and validate payments made via bank transfers, integrating directly with WooCommerce.

Main Features:

  • Unique code generation: Assigns a unique numeric reference to each order to easily identify the payer.
  • Automatic verification: Periodically checks the transaction status to approve the order as soon as the deposit is confirmed.
  • Friendly interface: Displays clear instructions, phone numbers, and exact amounts directly on the checkout and thank-you pages.
  • Visual timer: Circular countdown ring to guide the customer while waiting for payment confirmation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it directly from the WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and configure the payment method with your account details and credentials.
sections.faq:
Do I need a special banking API?

The plugin is designed to work with the notification and verification mechanism configured in the plugin settings for Costa Rica.

Does it work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes, it is compatible with most standard themes that respect WooCommerce hooks, and it includes optimized styles.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release: Payment gateway with automatic transaction verification via IMAP.
  • Manual confirmation available from WooCommerce > Pedidos SINPE to mark payments as received.
  • Checkout page is converted to the classic shortcode only with explicit administrator confirmation (not automatic).
